Be it ordained by the Mayor and Council of the town of Chipley, Georgia and it is hereby ordained by the authority of same, that from and after the adoption of this ordinance, any person or persons desiring to conduct a@ beef market, beef business or butcher shop where fresh meats, including fish and oysters, shail he kept for sale, shall make application to the Clerk of the town Council for a license to conduct said business and upon its payment to said Clerk of the sum of twenty five ($25.00) dollars and the making and depositing with the said office of a good and sufficient valid bond to be approved by said Clerk, in the sum of one hundred ($100.00) dollars, conditional upon the applicant running and conducting said beef market, beef business or butcher shop, continually for the space of twelve (12) months after the date of said license and keeping daily for sale beef or fresh meats for the space of tweive (12) months, shall receive from the Clerk of the Council a license authorizing such applicant to conduct said business for twelve (12) months.

It is further ordained that when it is made to appear to the Mayor that any person who may have obtained license to conduct the business mentioned in this license has violated any of the provisions of the Ordinance, the Mayor shall have the power and it shall be his duty to declare the license of such person so violating this ordinance null and void, and of no force and effect and to cancel the same and institute proceeding to Forfeit said bond, and it is further ordained that after the adoption of this ordinance any person or persons who shall sell or offer for sale beef or other fresh meats within the corporate limits of the town of Chipley without first having paid the sum of twenty five ($25.00) dollars and giving the bond herein required and obtaining a license to conduct said business, Shall upon conviction be fined by said Mayor in a sun not to exceed Fifth ($50.00) dollars or imprisonment in the town calaboose ar work in the town chaingang not to exceed thirty (30) days.

Adopted by Council of the town of Chipley. 1910
